exposure: one previous transverse lower segment cesarean section (LSCS)
Previous elective lower segment cesarean section (LSCS)
Nulliparous women, Primiparous women with one previous elective LSCS
outcome: Duration of active first stage of labor
Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: Primiparous women with one previous elective LSCS and nulliparous women with singleton pregnancy and spontaneous labor onset
finding: In women with one previous elective LSCS undergoing TOLAC, the progress and duration of labor are comparable to those in nulliparous women when labor is spontaneous and the pregnancy is singleton.
mod_finding: Women with one previous elective LSCS undergoing TOLAC and experiencing vaginal birth had similar progress and duration of labor compared to nulliparous women.
birth_weight: Higher birth weight in the VBAC group
